semantic_argument: The source condition |F|=Ω(λ·2^λ·d²·N²/log(1/ρ)) is an asymptotic lower bound requiring a sufficiently large field. The formal hF uses Fintype.card F ≤ ..., changing the applicability condition to an upper bound.

The source requires the existence of a protocol and treats rounds, proof length and query counts as properties of that protocol. The formal M comes from an outer variable declaration, while proofLen, qNumtoInput and qNumtoProofstr are implicit natural-number inputs preceding the root. No equation or definition relates them to the existential π, vPSpec or n.

Unfolding IsSecureWithGap shows only completeness and round-by-round knowledge soundness fields. It contains no mechanism binding the external resource parameters to π. Consequently, inequalities on those parameters do not express actual complexity bounds for the constructed protocol.

The complexity constants ∃c>0 and ∃c_k are quantified after secpar, degree, the field, resource counts and other inputs. Although c_k is a function of k, its choice can still depend on the other current inputs. This lacks the corresponding uniformity required by the source's O/O_k bounds.

For example, if degree>1 and k≥4, then log(degree)/log(k)>0. For each fixed degree, k and M, one can choose c large enough that M≤c·log(degree)/log(k). Such an instance-dependent constant does not imply a uniform logarithmic round bound as degree varies.
